judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec update, the `.lore/dod.md` planning file, and the failing acceptance tests, without ever modifying `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to actually fix the bug. Consequently, all three new tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail at runtime because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`. The candidate also failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria. Additionally, in the third test case (rejecting with `undefined`), the candidate didn't even assert that `error` was an `Error` instance with `'cause' in error && error.cause === undefined`. Finally, the reference placed the new test directly inside `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` rather than creating a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and committing `.lore/dod.md`.
